name: as.yearmon.default
title: An Index Class for Monthly Data

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An object that as.numeric can coerce.

origin.details: The default method calls as.yearmon(as.numeric(x)). A numeric string becomes a year fraction and is then snapped with yearmon. A string that is not numeric becomes NA. It does not parse month names.
origin.value: A numeric vector of class yearmon.

translation.description: Coerce to a Yearmon through a numeric conversion.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A number, a numeric string, or a sequence of those.

translation.details: Each element is read with float, then passed to yearmon. A string that is not a number becomes a missing value, with a warning. "2007-12" stays missing here; as_yearmon parses that string as December 2007.
translation.example:
import warnings
from zoo.yearmon import as_yearmon_default
with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter("ignore", RuntimeWarning)
    x = as_yearmon_default(["2000.25", "2007-12", "1"])
print(" ".join("NA" if v != v else format(float(v), ".17g") for v in x.value))
